title: Framer's AI agent designs, builds, and manages websites with you #webdesign #AItools #Framer
description: Framer’s latest update introduces an AI-powered agent that collaborates directly with users to design and build websites more efficiently. This agent automates traditionally fragmented tasks such as content management, SEO configuration, responsive design adjustments, publishing, and site-wide quality checks—all integrated into Framer’s platform. By consolidating these steps, the update eliminates the need to juggle multiple tools and teams, significantly streamlining the web development process. The core appeal lies in the balance between automation and user control; while the AI handles routine and technical tasks, users retain full creative direction and decision-making power. This innovation enhances productivity by reducing manual workload and accelerating time to launch, making it valuable for both individual creators and teams aiming for smoother web project workflows. #Framer #AIWebDesign #WebDevelopment #AItools #WebsiteBuilder #ResponsiveDesign #SEO #ContentManagement #DigitalDesign #ProductivityTools #TechInnovation #UserExperience #WebDesignAutomation #CreativeControl #SoftwareUpdate
